correctness.rationale: Let the 2-step graph Lie algebra L_m=F_q c+U+Z, [c,u]=z_u, with m>=2. Every idempotent Lie homomorphism has quotient block A=[[a,ell],[w,M]], central psi=aM-w ell and lift f satisfying fA+psi f=f. Bracket preservation forces ell(u)Mv=ell(v)Mu. If ell!=0, rank-one quotient projection and psi=0; if ell=0, a=0 or1 and M²=M with w in im M (a=0) or ker M (a=1). Counting Gaussian-Grassmannian image/kernel choices and lifts gives exact retraction enumerator P_mq and distinct image Q_mq as in RESULT.md, and image types abelian or smaller star without nonzero proper ideal retracts. The abelian rank-r term has weight H_mr q^{r(3m-2r+1)}, H_mr -> C_q uniformly in the O(1) central window r~(3m+1)/4; completing the square yields four total-variation residue-class discrete-Gaussian limits and nonabelian probability q^(-m²/8+O(m)). Independent exhaustive GF(2),m=2 enumeration of every idempotent bracket-preserving map confirmed map ranks {0:1,1:112,2:64,3:96,5:1}, total 274; distinct retract-image ranks {0:1,1:28,2:16,3:24,5:1}, total 70. These finite checks are not an all-prime-power proof.
residual_risks: The all-parameter conclusion requires the reconstructed symbolic proof, not just bounded computations.

The 2026 Gallo–Videla theorem about a graph Lie algebra retracting from its class-three balanced blow-up has a different family and existence-only conclusion: it does not count star class-two retracts. Generic Grassmannian formulas alone require the nontrivial bracket-compatible projection classification.
